title: ux-expert criteria catalogue for one area

area.description: File stem of the area reference, e.g. forms-input for references/areas/forms-input.md.

prefix.description: Criterion ID prefix for the area, e.g. FORM.

id.description: Permanent ID <PREFIX>-<NN>. Never renumbered or reused.

name.description: What good looks like, in a few words.

check.description: How to check it (code, runtime or measurement).

fail_signal.description: What a failure looks like, with thresholds where they exist.

severity.description: Default severity or range, per references/severity-and-scoring.md.

severity_note.description: Condition or escalation that changes the default.

related.description: Area prefixes or criterion IDs that share this concern.

status.description: Retired criteria keep their ID reserved and are left out of the tables.
